sees: frame 1: Warm peach background with diagonal stripes. Top-left tag 'INSIGHT 06 / 08 - TURN', top-right tag 'NOBODY WANTS TO READ YOUR SH*T'. Three circles in a row connected by a line: LEIA'S MESSAGE, OBI-WAN, DEATH STAR. A small orange dot sits on the line between Leia's Message and Obi-Wan.
frame 2: Same layout. The orange dot has moved along the line to between Obi-Wan and Death Star, near Obi-Wan.
frame 3: Same layout. The orange dot is now right next to the Death Star circle, at the end of the line.
changed: The orange dot travelled along the line from Leia's Message, through Obi-Wan, toward the Death Star.
cause: The dot appears to be something (the message) being passed along the chain; it is animated moving rightward. Nothing else is shown causing it.
effect: The message/item reaches the Death Star by way of Obi-Wan. The result is implied but not shown explicitly.
message: Leia's message was carried through Obi-Wan on its way to the Death Star, i.e. a message is relayed through an intermediary to reach its destination.
wouldConfuse: The dot is unlabeled, so it is unclear whether it is the message, information, or something else. The line has no arrowheads, and the 'turn' tag and the top-right caption do not obviously relate to the diagram.
